name: Morizono Inori
source:
A quiet and timid person, Inori tries her best to help those around her. Whether it be unifying her class as class president, or healing the other students with her abilities, she’s a selfless student who never gives up.

Always hard on herself, Inori counts on you to keep her spirits high. But when things begin to fall apart, will you be there to catch her?
